$comment: Recorded verbatim from https://inference.poolside.ai/v1 on 2026-09-26 (see research/raw/*.txt and live/probe.ts). Do not hand-edit: regenerate with `node live/make-error-fixtures.ts`.

no-auth-header.case: 401 plain text — no `Authorization` header at all
no-auth-header.note: The header is absent, not empty: `curl -H 'Authorization: ...'`-less requests only.

empty-bearer.case: 502 HTML — `Authorization: Bearer ` with an empty value
empty-bearer.note: Deterministic: 4/4 attempts returned this exact body. The front proxy answers, not the API.
empty-bearer.body:
Error: Server Error

The server encountered a temporary error and could not complete your request.

Please try again in 30 seconds.

bad-key-listing.case: 403 with NO readable body — the server resets the stream on GET /models with a wrong key
bad-key-listing.note: Reproduced repeatedly: node/undici reports `403` and then `terminated` (ERR_HTTP2_STREAM_ERROR NGHTTP2_INTERNAL_ERROR), and `curl` independently reports `HTTP/2 stream 1 reset by server (error 0x2 INTERNAL_ERROR)` after `HTTP 403`, over both h2 and http1.1. The *status* is deterministic (0.3-0.5 s) but the body never arrives, so this fixture records a status without a body.

bad-key-chat.case: 403 `{"error":"<string>"}` on POST /chat/completions with a wrong key
bad-key-chat.note: Same dialect on the chat route; ~0.4 s, deterministic.

empty-json-body.note: A rejection, so it is free and proves the key authenticated.

max-tokens-range.case: 400 enveloped `{"error":{"code","message","type"}}` for max_tokens over the cap
max-tokens-range.note: Discloses the ceiling (262144) pre-inference, for free.

extra-inputs.note: `Extra inputs are not permitted` — the listing field is not a request field.

temperature-range.case: 400 enveloped `Validation: Temperature must be between 0 and 2`
temperature-range.note: Same envelope as the max_tokens range error.

embeddings-absent.note: Surface check: no embedding model is listed.
